literal_meaning: যেমন এখানে তেমনি সেখানে (as here, so there)
example_sentences_in_bangla: কুপুত্র হয় যথাতথা কুমাতা নয় কখনো।
example_sentences_in_english: A bad son may be born anywhere, but a bad mother never.
history: Originates from ancient Sanskrit proverbs, often attributed to Chanakya's teachings, emphasizing universality in human experiences.
note: Commonly used in Bengali literature and folklore to denote omnipresence or inevitability.
